office: an Eritrean embassy or consulate abroad (here the Consulate General in Toronto), or its volunteer local representative

routes.label: a new passport, through the consulate
renewing a passport issued after 2010, through the consulate

note: The Consulate General in Toronto's passport page: 300 dollars for an adult's new passport and 150 to renew one issued after 2010, 225 and 115 for the under-age (the renewal written as a renewal route); read as Canadian dollars, the consulate taking money orders and bank drafts in Canada. 'Under age' is taken as under 18. The fee in Eritrea, validity and time aren't read: no Eritrean government page with them was found.

sources.title: The Consulate General of the State of Eritrea in Toronto, Canada, Eritrean Passport
sources.said: Payment Information: All payments for Consular Services should be made via money order or Bank draft. Please make the payment payable to “Consulate of Eritrea.” NEW/RENEWAL/LOST PASSPORT ... NEW PASSPORT FEE: $300.00 MONEY-ORDER: PAYABLE TO CONSULATE OF ERITREA. PASSPORT RENEWAL FEE $150.00. PASSPORT MUST BE ISSUED AFTER 2010 ... UNDER_AGE REQUIREMENTS ... PASSPORT FEE: $225.00 MONEY ORDER ... PASSPORT REPLACEMENT FEE $115.00. PASSPORT MUST BE ISSUED AFTER 2010
